slides.title: The Daily 3: the only cleaning routine my ADHD brain didn't quit
Why big routines die
slides.body: A 20-step routine works for 4 days. On day 5 you miss one step and the whole thing feels broken.

slides.title: The Daily 3
slides.body: Three tiny tasks, every day, in any order. That's it. Some days you'll do more. Three is still a win.

slides.title: My Daily 3
items: Run the dishwasher or clear the sink
One load of laundry moved forward

slides.title: Move it forward, not finished
slides.body: Laundry doesn't need to go from dirty to drawer today. Washer to dryer counts. Progress counts.

slides.title: Put it where you'll see it
slides.body: On the fridge, by the coffee maker, taped to the mirror. If it's in an app, it's already forgotten.

slides.title: 3 things done every day beats 30 things done once a month.
Get the Daily 3 on your fridge
